name: Gul
body: I ordered the complete Safa Bliss bundle a month ago - the shampoo, oil, anti-acne soap and brightening ubtan soap – and honestly it’s been a game changer. Within two weeks my scalp felt clean and fresh, hair fall reduced noticeably, and I’ve even started noticing tiny baby hairs appearing along my hairline, which I never expected so soon! The oil has a lovely natural aroma and leaves my hair softer and stronger. The anti-acne soap calmed my breakouts without drying my skin, and the ubtan soap gives a soft glow after every shower. It’s rare to find products that are truly natural and still deliver real results. Highly recommended!

body: I was with in a meeting with one of my client and he mentioned that I am loosing hair very quickly. He recommended that I use Minoxidil and other chemical based solutions. Since I had tried Minoxidil once few years ago and also some medicine in tablet form as well, but didn't get any results. This time, I started using Safa Bliss Natural's Miracle Hair Oil and Shampoo in August and I am surprised by the results. Previously I had slow hair growth, now my hair have started growing rapidly. I was experiencing a lot of hair fall, both in my head and beard, now i only see 2-3 hairs. I have noticed new hair growth Alhamdulillah. My son mentioned that my beard hair have become very soft, previously they were very hard. I have also noticed visible difference in the shine of my hair. Amazing products.
